description: 佐賀県統計年鑑_第26章_司法及び警察 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 佐賀県統計年鑑(H30)第26章「司法及び警察」のデータです. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are 統計年鑑. It offers 24 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2020-11-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
